visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: One Loop for Both Diagonals
visualizerParams.problemDescription: Each diagonal is added with hand-written indexes. Use one loop over a named size. The output must stay the same.

solution.explanation: The pattern m[i][i] and m[i][N - 1 - i] works for any size. Hand-written indexes would have to be edited for every new matrix size.
